authorship: Reviewer authored only private test fixtures, not reviewed product controls.
deployed_source_equivalence: Exact source bytes after the normal built-in res://addons/ainative/ preload prefix rewrite; no other difference.

execution.kind: Actual isolated offscreen native editor, actual saved colored GLB, disconnected local-copy node only.
execution.injection: Actual InputEventMouseButton and InputEventMouseMotion objects injected through the root viewport push_input method; no direct call to the product input handler.

proven_behaviors: Left-button drag changes camera position while preserving focus distance.
Middle-button drag moves camera and focus by the same vector and preserves camera orientation.
Wheel-up decreases distance; wheel-down restores it. Repeated wheel input respects 0.1 and 3.0 times the frame-distance bounds.
Double-click restores the complete framed camera transform after orbit, pan and zoom.
Run identity, transport serial, current result, preview identity and executor database bytes remain unchanged during camera input. No job starts and the graph remains idle.
The isolated executor database contains one successful run with only the disconnected local-copy node; the saved source GLB digest remains unchanged.
limitations: This input test establishes camera interaction and no regeneration; it does not accept mesh likeness, reconstruction quality or inferred hidden surfaces.
Native forced-exit logs contain existing rendering resource cleanup warnings; no claim of a warning-free shutdown.
The native editor was tested offscreen at its actual root viewport size; physical mouse feel and every display layout were not tested.
privacy: Public source and binary identifiers, generic behavior assertions and camera measurements only; original image paths, image content, generated asset data and workflow identity remain private.
